drawings.description: feuillet de croquis : trois diagrammes et quelques lignes, sans titre
drawings.notes: Top: A_0 B_0 and A B each joined by two oblique strokes to S_0 and S; S_0 -> T_0', S <-> T' (a struck word over the double arrow), S_0 -> T_0, T_0' -> T_0, S - Spec k = T, T' -> T, and "Z - T_0 ---- Spec k = T" along the bottom; A_x -> B_x at the top right. Then the lines A_{0 T_0'} -> B_{0 T_0'} and "A B   A_T -> B_T". Below: S <- T, upward arrows from S' -> T', and double upward arrows from S'' -> T''. The text block at the lower right is left out.

drawings.description: croquis au crayon, au-dessus du trait : un $X'$ biffé d'où partent deux flèches vers $Y$, trois $\Omega$ dont un biffé, et un mot illisible sous le trait
drawings.kind: pencil sketch above a line: X' struck, arrows, Omegas, diagonal strokes
drawings.notes: Pencil: a struck X' (with an X above it) from which two arrows go right towards Y (placed after the transcription), three long diagonal strokes down to a horizontal line, the labels Omega^1, Omega^1_{X'/Y'} with a struck symbol and a dash before it, and Omega^1_{X/Y} lower left. A small square Y~ - X~ over Y - X at the top left, also pencil, is drawn. The word under the line is not read and left out; the typed text showing through from the back is not reproduced. Labels are approximate readings.
